description: Official Ovia Labs documentation: the whitepaper, roadmap and documentation for Ovia Protect, Ovia Network and the proposed OVIA Token.

components.name: Ovia Labs
components.today: An independent, early-stage initiative. The website ovialabs.xyz and this documentation are live.

components.name: Ovia Protect
components.today: Public beta since 18 November 2026 at protect.ovialabs.xyz: a read-only ERC-20 approval scanner for Ethereum Mainnet. Not yet independently reviewed.

components.name: Ovia Network
components.today: A research direction. There is no specification, code, network or verifier set.

components.name: OVIA Token
components.today: An exploratory concept. No token, contract, supply, allocation or launch plan exists.

components.name: Developer API and SDK
components.today: No public API, SDK or integration interface exists or has been specified.

revisions.changes: Ovia Protect public beta: product, technical design, security and scope pages describe the released beta; roadmap phases 01 and 02 completed and phase 03 started; whitepaper chapters 1, 4, 5, 6, 9, 10 and 11 updated; release requirements in chapter 6 now apply before Ovia Protect leaves beta.
Initial documentation release: whitepaper v0.1 (12 chapters), Ovia Protect, Ovia Network and OVIA Token documentation, roadmap, developer overview and resources.
